meta.name: chrome-automation
meta.description: Connect to and control Google Chrome browser using agent-browser with CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol). Use when the user wants to automate their existing Chrome browser, see browser actions in real-time, or needs to control the Chrome instance they're already using. Handles installation, setup, connecting via remote debugging, and all browser automation tasks with live visual feedback.

copy.tagline: 用真实浏览器自动执行网页操作并实时查看反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制Chrome浏览器完成重复网页操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate web tasks in your real Chrome browser with live visual feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control Chrome programmatically for repetitive web tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 agent-browser 连接并控制你电脑上正在运行的 Chrome 浏览器,自动完成打开网页、填写表单、点击、搜索等操作。每次操作你都能在浏览器窗口实时看到,并收到截图和当前页面状态的说明。
howto.when: 当你想自动化你自己正在用的 Chrome 浏览器、要求实时看到浏览器操作,或要控制当前已打开的 Chrome 实例时触发。注意需要先运行自动安装脚本完成环境检查。

say.text: 打开小红书,搜索 labubu 并截图结果。
帮我在当前页面填写表单并提交。
say.note: Claude 获取页面可交互元素后自动填表和提交。

say.text: 看看浏览器现在是什么状态,截个图。
say.note: Claude 连接 Chrome 后截图并描述所见内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can connect to and control the user's running Chrome browser via agent-browser, performing tasks like opening pages, filling forms, clicking, and searching. Every action is visible in real time, and Claude provides screenshots and a description of the current page state.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when the user asks to automate their existing Chrome browser, see browser actions in real-time, or control the Chrome instance they are already using. A mandatory auto-install check runs first to set up dependencies.

say_en.text: Open Xiaohongshu, search for labubu, and screenshot the results.
say_en.note: Claude opens the page, searches, and sends a screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill out the form on this page and submit it.
say_en.note: Claude fetches interactive elements, fills and submits.

say_en.text: What's the browser showing now? Take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude connects, screenshots, and describes the page.
